COURT TRIAL
Off Calendar Mar-07-2006 Judgment Entered
MINI MINUTES: This matter came regularly on calendar this day, by assignment from the Department of the Presiding Judge for Court Trial/Prove-Up.
Dept. 218, Comm. Sue Kaplan, Clerk: E. Bura, CSR: Ron Sinclair.
Elizabeth MacDonald, Esq. Special Appearance for Plaintiff: Charters Adjustments Corporation.
Plaintiff's Witnesses: Leanne Spatafore and Deirdre Murphy, were sworn and examined.
No appearance by the Defendant: Retromark LLC DBA DiFini Sportswear
After hearing the evidence presented, the Court rules in favor of the Plaintiff and against Defendant as follows:
Principal $14,242.81
Prejudgment Interest $2,207.64
Attorney Fees $1,000.00
(Entitled to court costs pursuant to memorandum of costs), for a Total of $17,450.45
Judgment granted in open court.
Counsel will submit proposed judgment tomorrow.

Mar. 7, 2006
Judgment signed by Comm. Kaplan.
